queue.heading: Report queue
queue.intro: Most urgent first. Our own moderators act on reports. The only automatic check is on pictures: it holds a flagged picture for a moderator and never decides on its own.
queue.grouped: Reports about the same item are grouped into one case.
queue.notAllowed: Only moderation staff can see the queue.

tierSummary.heading: Open cases by tier
tierSummary.one_hour: Removal orders from an authority (EU law gives us one hour)
tierSummary.same_day: Child abuse material, a threat to a minor, a self-harm risk or terrorist content
tierSummary.two_days: Other illegal content, such as copied work
tierSummary.seven_days: Everything else: insults, spam, off-topic posts

case.heading: Case {{reference}}
case.notFound: There is no case here, or it is not one you can see.
case.notAllowed: Only moderation staff can open a case.
case.summaryOrder: {{what}}. A removal order from an authority, received {{when}}. The one-hour clock started on receipt.
case.summaryPicture: {{what}}. Held by the picture check {{when}}; nobody else has seen it.
case.noReports: No reports: this case came from an order or a picture check.
case.anonymous: Reporters are never named to the reported account.
case.decidedNotice: This case is decided: {{action}}. Appeals come with S1-E10-07; until then the person can challenge it through Contact us.

form.heading: Decision
form.noteHint: What you checked and why you chose this action. Only staff can read it.
form.noteMissing: Write a note to send the decision.
form.sent: Decision saved. The case is closed and its reports with it.
form.nextSteps: The action is carried out at once: a warning, a suspension, a ban, hiding or removing. The person gets a statement of reasons, each reporter is told the outcome, and anyone who used the public form gets an email.
form.daysMissing: Choose how long the suspension lasts.
form.messageHint: This goes into their statement of reasons: what happened and why, in plain words they understand. Don’t name the reporter.
form.messageMissing: Write what we tell the person. Every decision except “No action” sends them a statement of reasons.

case.summary: {{what}}. Reports: {{count}}, the first received {{when}}. Reports about the same item are grouped here.
case.noStatement: No statement was sent: either the decision was “No action”, or the authority’s order said not to tell the uploader.

failures.not_allowed: You can’t do this. Only moderation staff can, and safeguarding cases need the safeguarding permission.
failures.refused: The database refused it: the note may be empty, or the case is already decided.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach our server. Check your connection and try again.
failures.not_built: Restricting an item comes with S1-E11-08.

reason.hint: Goes into the audit log. Only staff can read it.

moderatedItem.hidden: The item is hidden: the writer and staff still see it.
moderatedItem.removed: The item is removed: only staff see it; everyone else sees “[Removed by the moderation team]”.
moderatedItem.explain: Staff never edit a writer’s words. Restoring brings the item back as it was.

notices.anonymous: No name or email given (allowed for child sexual content)
notices.ordersHeading: Removal orders received in the last 7 days
notices.orderUnmatched: The address matched nothing we host: check it below.
notices.unmatchedIntro: The address in these notices matched nothing we host. Check each one, act on the content if you find it, then close the notice with what you found.

copied.question: What do you need to know?
copied.askLabel: Ask for more details from the reporter of {{reference}}

orders.heading: Removal order
orders.intro: EU law gives us one hour from receipt to take the item down. Emergency disable takes it down everywhere at once, keeps it for six months for the authorities, and tells the authority by email.
orders.nobodyOnCall: Nobody was on call, so everyone on call was alerted at once.
orders.escalated: Nobody acknowledged it in time, so it went to the whole team at {{when}}.
orders.tellUploader: Tell the uploader (untick only if the order says not to)
orders.messageHint: Their statement of reasons. Name the authority and the order; don’t add anything the order asks us to keep confidential.
orders.missing: Write a note, and the message to the uploader if they are told.
orders.done: Taken down everywhere. The item is kept for six months and the authority is being told.

failures.not_allowed: Only staff on call for removal orders can use Emergency disable.
failures.refused: The database refused it: the case may already be decided, or the note is empty.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach our server. Try again now: the one-hour clock is running.

safeguarding.heading: Safeguarding

steps.risk: Read the reports and the content. Is anyone at risk right now?
steps.emergency: If a life is at risk, call 112 first, then carry on here.
steps.contacts: Give the person the helpline below in your message, in their language.
steps.evidence: Build the evidence pack if the police or a helpline will need it.
steps.refer: Log every referral to an authority below, with their reference.
steps.decide: Decide the case. The decision and the statement of reasons follow the usual rules.

safeguarding.contactsFallback: We have no contacts for their country yet, so these are Romania’s. The gap is noted for the safety contacts list.
safeguarding.noContacts: No contacts are stored for this country.
safeguarding.packIntro: A file with the content, the account’s details, the reports and every timestamp, to hand to the police or a helpline. Building it is logged as a sensitive read. It holds the account’s email: keep it only as long as the referral needs it.
safeguarding.authority: Authority (for example the police or a child protection service)
safeguarding.moveIntro: If this case is really about a child at risk, move it to the safeguarding lane. Only staff with the safeguarding permission will see it.
safeguarding.moveReason: Why does it belong in safeguarding?
safeguarding.moved: Moved to safeguarding. Staff with that permission now handle it.

decisionEmails.heading: Decision emails waiting: {{count}}
decisionEmails.intro: People who used the public report form are told the decision by email. These didn’t leave after the decision; send them now.

onCall.heading: On call
onCall.intro: Who answers a removal order from an authority. The person on call is alerted first; if nobody acknowledges within 15 minutes, everyone with the on-call permission is alerted. With nobody on call, everyone is alerted at once.
onCall.notAllowed: Only staff can see the on-call rota.
onCall.nobodyNow: Nobody is on call right now. An order arriving now alerts everyone with the on-call permission.
onCall.noGaps: Someone is on call for the whole of the next 14 days.
onCall.missing: Fill in every field, with the end after the start.

failures.not_allowed: Only owners and admins can change the rota.
failures.refused: The database refused it: the person may not have the on-call permission, or the shift overlaps another.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach our server. Check your connection and try again.

claims.heading: Who is on it
claims.mine: You have claimed this case. Others see it is yours for the next hour.
claims.refused: Someone else claimed this case less than an hour ago. Ask them, or try again later.

picture.heading: The picture
picture.alt: The uploaded picture this case is about
picture.matchHidden: This picture matched known child sexual abuse material. It is never shown here: follow the safeguarding steps. The file is kept as evidence.
picture.unreadable: We couldn't open the picture. Try again in a moment.
picture.decisionHint: No action approves the picture and shows it. Any other decision removes it, and the uploader gets a statement of reasons.

appeals.heading: Appeals
appeals.intro: People can appeal a decision for six months. A different moderator decides where possible. Changing a decision restores what was hidden or removed and lifts a sanction; the person is told either way.
appeals.notAllowed: Only staff who decide appeals can see this page.
appeals.why: Why they think it is wrong
appeals.notYours: You made the original decision, so another moderator decides this appeal.
appeals.noteHint: Why you decided this. Only staff see it.
appeals.messageHint: Required: the person must be told the reasons. Plain words, no staff names.

embed.heading: The music or video card
embed.title: Title
embed.author: Channel or artist
embed.decisionHint: Open the link in a new tab to judge it; nothing from the service loads on this page. Removing the item takes away this one card, and the chapter stays up.
